lines.speaker: ade
lines.text: I will not beg you. I have got three hundred people on this rock who will find out in the spring, and I would rather be the one who knew all winter.

lines.speaker: ade
lines.text: When you go back up those stairs, look at what you kept.

lines.speaker: dax
lines.text: You're letting my people die on schedule. Forty years before I'm born, on schedule, because that's how it already went.

lines.speaker: dax
lines.text: I'll remember that. Both versions. That's the thing nobody warned me about — I'll remember both.

lines.speaker: wren
lines.text: Something is wrong. Listen — not to the valley. The Wardens are not in the valley.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The Board was waiting. Not for the armoury; for the decision. Somebody down there knew which way it would go before you did.
